lines.t: Lyrics:
Verse 1
I got a fire in my chest, can’t shut it down
Tried to fit their mold but I was breaking out
Every scar, every lie they threw my way
Turned to fuel, now I’m done with yesterday
Pre-Chorus
I was lost in the noise, couldn’t hear the truth
Now I’m louder than the fear they fed my youth
Chorus
I’m not backing down, I’m alive right now
Got a voice, gonna scream it out loud
YahuShua pulled me from the dark somehow
Yeah I’m standing on the truth I found
No more chains, no more hiding out
I’m lit up and I’m unashamed now
YahuShua, yeah You turned my life around
Verse 2
They said I’d never be enough, just fade away
But I’m rising like a storm I couldn’t stay
Every doubt that tried to break my soul
Got shattered when You took control
Pre-Chorus
I was chasing empty highs, falling every time
Now I’m steady in a love that never lies
Chorus
I’m not backing down, I’m alive right now
Got a voice, gonna scream it out loud
YahuShua pulled me from the dark somehow
Yeah I’m standing on the truth I found
No more chains, no more hiding out
I’m lit up and I’m unashamed now
YahuShua, yeah You turned my life around
Bridge
I won’t go back, I won’t break
I found the truth they couldn’t take
Through every doubt, through every scar
You showed me who I really are
Yeah, I’m done with the lies
I see through their disguise
YahuShua, You opened my eyes
Final Chorus
I’m not backing down, I’m alive right now
Got a voice, gonna scream it out loud
YahuShua pulled me from the dark somehow
Yeah I’m standing on the truth I found
No more chains, no more hiding out
I’m lit up and I’m unashamed now
Yeah I’m living for the fire I found
Outro
Yeah I’m loud, yeah I’m free
This is who I’m meant to be
